name: Code
tip: Write a geogram wapp in C. Hit Compile to build it against the bundled wasm-clang, then Install to add it to the launcher.

children.name: source
children.label: source.c
children.tip: Plain C against the geogram HAL (wapps/hal/geogram_wasm_hal.h). No libc.

children.name: compile
children.label: Compile
children.tip: Run the bundled wasm-clang over the source above. Output goes to the log view below.

children.name: install
children.label: Install
children.tip: Write the compiled wapp into the launcher's installed-apps folder. Requires a successful compile first.

children.name: output
children.label: Compiler output
children.tip: Compiler stdout and stderr, plus host-side progress messages.

name: Settings
tip: Metadata for the wapp that will be produced. These values end up in the generated manifest.json when you click Install.

children.name: Identity
children.tip: Identifying information baked into the new wapp's manifest.

children.name: wapp_id
children.label: Wapp id
children.tip: Reverse-domain identifier. Used as the installed-apps folder name.

children.name: wapp_description
children.label: Description
children.default: A wapp I wrote inside geogram.

name: UI
tip: Visual drag-and-drop UI editor. Not yet implemented — reserved as a tab so the layout stays stable once it lands.

children.text: A visual editor that lets you drag-and-drop GeoUI groups, fields and actions directly into the home screen JSON will live here. For now, edit screens/home.ui.json by hand (the 'tasks' and 'tester' wapps are good references).
